output: Doubling headcount over two years is a real planning concern, and you're right that a per-seat price can look very different by the second renewal. Per-seat pricing does grow with adoption, but we can manage that. Contributor and viewer seats are lower-cost options for occasional users, so you don't need to pay full price for everyone who needs access. Multi-year terms can also cap the annual increase. For a sense of scale, [PLACEHOLDER] pricing example: three-year cost for a company with mostly contributor seats. I'd like to send you a three-year cost model at your expected user mix, with the renewal cap options side by side, so you can compare them against your hiring plan.
